title: Unity 2: Acting Together
coreMove: Create togetherness through shared action before the request rather than merely naming shared identity.
sourcePressure: The source says We relationships can also be produced by synchronized or collaborative activity, increasing liking and support through acting together.

hook: An abstract claim that attention changes everything
A generic meeting where someone makes a better pitch
A clever sentence about persuasion before any concrete object appears
counterintuition: You think persuasion happens during the ask, but it happens before it
The obvious factor is not always the important one
Influence is not manipulation when used well
tryThisNow: Set a timer and reflect on attention
Write down three ways to be more persuasive
Ask yourself what matters most right now

exampleSpecs.audience: a coach asking members to adopt stricter launch rules
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether synchronized warmups make support easier before the vote
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the coach has mixed crews row a short cadence together before opening the rule vote
exampleSpecs.firstImage: oars rising at the same count before dawn practice

exampleSpecs.audience: a supervisor building cooperation between rival shifts
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether collaborative inspection creates We before the overtime request
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the supervisor pairs one day worker and one night worker to sign the same machine check before asking for shared overtime
exampleSpecs.firstImage: two signatures on a machine-check tag

exampleSpecs.audience: a therapist helping anxious children support one another
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether synchronized breathing changes how they respond to a group task
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the therapist has children breathe with the same pinwheel before asking them to practice in pairs
exampleSpecs.firstImage: pinwheels spinning together on a low table

exampleSpecs.audience: a professor asking students to maintain shared equipment
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether doing the first cleanup together precedes rule acceptance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the professor cleans one microscope station alongside students before assigning the rotation
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a microscope lens cloth beside a sign-up strip

exampleSpecs.audience: a company asking angry customers to help redesign packaging
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether collaborative action changes the relationship before feedback
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the facilitator has customers sort failed package tabs with staff before the survey opens
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a table covered with torn package tabs

exampleSpecs.audience: an organizer asking business owners to back a public art plan
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether shared painting creates support before a permit signature
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the organizer has owners paint one test tile together before handing over the permit letter
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a wet ceramic tile on a newspaper-covered table

skillTargets: create We through synchronized or collaborative action
time shared action before the ask
transfer acting-together logic across teams and customers

tryThisNowSpec: Design a thirty-second shared action that happens before the request and directly relates to the support you need.
